answer.label: quantized
answer.justification: The activation profile matches quantization: relative L2 is 0.092 at layer 1, rises to 0.179 at layer 8, then stays nearly flat (0.191 at layer 16, 0.201 at layer 24) and ends at 0.249. Final cosine is 0.968, effective rank 4.14 (noise-like), direction consistency 0.520, mid-layer size ratio 0.968 (shrinks), and onset layer 10. KL is 0.032 with TV 0.043, the smallest logit change, and top-1 agreement 0.943 is near the quantized range. Median first divergence of 9.5 and edit distance 0.505 also fit quantized. Fine-tuned is ruled out because its size ratio would be above 1 and its direction consistency higher (0.62+). System-prompted is ruled out because the median divergence would be 0, the layer-2 spike would be 30+ (here 0.2), and KL would be 0.2+. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
